Question Choices: A checking account holds $42.50 when a debit of $58.75 is posted. Fill in the blanks: the new balance is 42.50 + ___ = ___.
Hints: Use plus for gains/deposits and minus for losses/withdrawals; include an initial value only when asked for the final value.
Solution: 42.50 + (-58.75) = -16.25, so the account is overdrawn by $16.25. Keep each sign with its change. The final value is the starting value plus all changes; a total profit/debt is a sum of the stated signed amounts. Exact check: -58.75 = -58.75; 42.50-58.75 = -16.25.
